verdicts.reason: A blows the small cross icon up into a huge, blurry blue cross that dominates the middle of the banner, leaving it heavily pixelated and destroying the hierarchy. A also scatters the pieces: the dates are tiny and pinned to the top edge, 'Worship & Bible Study' floats on its own, and the invite copy sits far below the headline. B keeps the original elements at their proper scale and reads left to right with the illustration on the right, but it is cramped: the invite line runs into the cross and the 'Worship' text, the small dates are left-aligned while the headline is centred, the illustration is cut off at the bottom, and there is dead space on the left.
